svg.title: MovieLens Data Engineering Pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Left-to-right data flow: MovieLens 20M to Amazon S3 to Snowflake to dbt (Staging, Dimensions and Facts, Data Mart) to SQL Analytics and Streamlit Dashboard; Snowflake ratings to Apache Spark PySpark MLlib ALS to Snowflake Recommendation Table to Streamlit Recommendation Page with User ID to Top 10 recommendations.
svg.text: End-to-end architecture: ingestion, transformation, analytics and ML recommendations
